questions.stem: If 5 of 7 themes recur in a similar context, how many did not recur?
questions.explanation: Seven minus five is two. Non-recurring themes highlight context differences.

questions.subject: RESEARCH_METHODS
questions.topic: A mixed-design claim its integration point contradicts

stimulus.body: A study initially claims convergence, but integration reveals divergence. The debate team asks what to do next.

questions.stem: What should the researchers do next?

options.text: Rewrite data to show convergence
Suppress the integration results
Discard the study
Revise the claim and investigate the divergence

questions.explanation: Revise and investigate. Suppressing, discarding, or rewriting is unethical or wasteful.

questions.subject: RESEARCH_METHODS
questions.topic: What a small disagreement review can show
questions.stem: Which statement best captures the value of a small disagreement review?

options.text: It proves the codebook is final
It identifies where codes or coders misalign before full analysis
It replaces inter-coder agreement checks
It guarantees no future disagreements

questions.explanation: Disagreement reviews catch misalignment early. They do not prove finality, replace agreement checks, or guarantee future alignment.
